title: Greedy
learn: greedy choice property, exchange argument (why it works), Kadane's algorithm, when greedy fails (→ DP)
hook: Jump Game, Maximum Subarray, Gas Station and Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II are greedy classics. The interview skill isn't writing the loop, it's explaining WHY taking the locally best choice is safe, or spotting when it isn't.

explain.prompt: Explain what makes a greedy algorithm correct, using Jump Game or Assign Cookies, and give an example where greedy fails.
keyPoints: greedy makes the locally best choice and never undoes it
it's correct when an exchange argument shows the greedy choice can replace any optimal choice without making things worse
Jump Game: track the farthest reachable index; if the current index is beyond it, you're stuck; O(n), O(1)
counterexample: coin change with coins 1, 3, 4 and amount 6 (greedy 3 coins, optimal 2), which needs DP
greedy is usually O(n) after an O(n log n) sort
